candidate_source_workflow.workflow_name: Build East Asia public SRA Compositae1061 pilot

locus_rule: All four scenarios use the exact intersection of the accepted baseline loci, EA01 strict loci, and EA02 strict loci.
promotion_requires: retain at least 100 joint paired loci under the frozen baseline gate
run baseline294, EA01-only, EA02-only, and EA01+EA02 on the identical paired locus set
quantify the 294-shared-tip backbone change rather than assuming augmentation is harmless
verify EA01 reproduces the existing Cirsium nipponicum var. yoshinoi placement across mapping and tree sensitivities
verify EA02 placement is concordant across BWA and BLASTx concatenated trees and source-label coalescent sensitivity
do not weaken locus or topology gates post hoc to admit a preferred candidate
